── INES'S WEEK ──
Ines ran about 40 km a week before a stress reaction in the left shin and ten weeks off, and a physio has cleared Ines for walk-run three days a week, stopping if the shin aches. The goal is to run 30 minutes without walking by mid-October.
Recent weeks: none recorded.
This week: 5.1 km over 3 runs.
Body: "Shin quiet."
Feeling: "Nervous but happy to be back."

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Ines: Your shin stayed quiet through all three walk-runs, so the next step is to lift the running intervals from about 1 minute to 2 minutes…
The signal from last week was clean, so a small step forward is appropriate. Pain stayed at 0/10 on Mon, Wed and Sat, your body check said the shin was quiet, and heart rate stayed in Z1 and Z2 the whole time.
Safety flag: Stop any run if the shin aches
Next week:
Mon: easy, walk-run 15 min, 2 min walk warm-up then 4 rounds of 2 min easy running and 1…
Tue: other, physio calf and hip routine. Keeps the lower-leg work the physio asked for…
Wed: easy, walk-run 15 min, 2 min walk warm-up then 4 rounds of 2 min easy running and 1…
Thu: other, physio calf and hip routine. Second strength day, well clear of Wednesday's…
Fri: rest. Full day off before the slightly longer walk-run on Saturday.
Sat: easy, walk-run 18 min, 2 min walk warm-up then 5 rounds of 2 min easy running and 1…
Sun: rest. Full recovery day to see how the shin feels the morning after Saturday.
